name: ResourceBundle
observations: Foundation bundle providing shared components and patterns
Location: src/CoreShop/Bundle/ResourceBundle/Resources/assets/pimcore-studio/
Exports as @coreshop/resource package
Provides EntityApi for CRUD operations
Contains EntityTabbedManager, EntityManager, GroupedEntityTabbedManager
Defines extension registries: EntityFormExtensionRegistry, EntityTableColumnExtensionRegistry, EntitySaveDecoratorRegistry
Provides localization system: LocalizationProvider, LocalizedFieldsProvider, useLocalization()
Includes DroppableEntity for drag-and-drop support
No widgets of its own - pure shared library
Service IDs: 'CoreShop/Studio/EntityFormExtensions', 'CoreShop/Studio/EntityTableColumnExtensions', 'CoreShop/Studio/EntitySaveDecorators'
IMPORTANT FIX: Must register all three extension registries in main.ts onInit()
Bug fixed: EntityTableColumnExtensionRegistry was missing from container registration
All three registries must be bound: entityFormExtensionsServiceId, entityTableColumnExtensionsServiceId, entitySaveDecoratorsServiceId

name: EntityApi
observations: Generic CRUD API client class from ResourceBundle
Type parameter <TDetail> for entity detail type
Constructor accepts EntityApiConfig with basePath and resourcePath
Methods: list(), get(id), add(payload), save(payload), delete(id)
Default routes: /list, /get, /add, /save, /delete
Returns EntityGetResponse<T> with {data, success} structure
List returns Array<EntityListItem> with {id, name}
Used by all feature bundles to create API instances

name: EntityFormExtensionRegistry
observations: Allows bundles to inject form fields into other bundles' forms
Methods: add(slotId, renderer), list(slotId)
Slot naming: '{bundle}.{resource}.{component}.{slot}' e.g. 'coreshop.address.country.form'
Renderer receives props: {data, onChange, currentLocale, form}
Access via: container.get<EntityFormExtensionRegistry>(entityFormExtensionsServiceId)
Render in forms via: renderEntityFormExtensions(slotId, props)
Example: CoreBundle extends CountryForm with CurrencySelect

name: EntityTableColumnExtensionRegistry
observations: Extends table columns in nested tables within forms
Methods: add(slotId, columnFactory), list(slotId)
Column factory receives {updateRecord} callback
Returns array of Ant Design column definitions
Example: CoreBundle adds Country/State columns to TaxRuleGroup tax rules table
Access via: container.get(entityTableColumnExtensionsServiceId)
Retrieve in components via: getEntityTableColumnExtensions(slotId, updateRecord)
Must be registered in ResourceBundle main.ts onInit() method
Service ID: 'CoreShop/Studio/EntityTableColumnExtensions'
Registration pattern: container.bind(entityTableColumnExtensionsServiceId).to(EntityTableColumnExtensionRegistry).inSingletonScope()
Common error if missing: 'No matching bindings found for serviceIdentifier'

name: EntitySaveDecoratorRegistry
observations: Transforms save payloads before API submission
Methods: add(resourceKey, decorator), apply(resourceKey, payload, data)
Decorator function receives payload and optional data, returns modified payload
Allows bundles to add/modify fields when saving entities
Used in managers before calling api.save()
Example usage: registry.apply('/coreshop/countries', basePayload, data)

name: EntityTabbedManager
observations: Primary manager component for entity CRUD operations
Generic type parameter <TDetail>
Props: api (EntityApi), dragType, localizable, onAdd, buildSavePayload, renderDetail, getTitle, leftRootTitle
Provides tabbed interface for editing multiple entities
Left sidebar shows entity list, right side shows detail form
Handles save/reload with EntityFooterToolbar
Integrates with EntitySaveDecoratorRegistry automatically
Supports drag-and-drop for entity references
Example: TaxRateManager, CountryManager, TaxRuleGroupManager

name: GroupedEntityTabbedManager
observations: Extension of EntityTabbedManager with grouping support
Adds groupBy prop to organize entities into groups
Example: Countries grouped by Zone
Groups displayed as collapsible sections in left sidebar
All other features same as EntityTabbedManager

name: PluginSystem
observations: Every bundle exports IAbstractPlugin from main.ts
Plugin has name, onInit(), onStartup({moduleSystem})
onInit() runs first - sets up container services, registers widgets
onStartup() runs after - registers modules with moduleSystem
Plugin name format: 'coreshop-{bundle-name}'
Default export must be the plugin object
Loaded via Module Federation at runtime

name: ModuleSystem
observations: Modules are AbstractModule objects with onInit() method
Registered in plugin onStartup() via moduleSystem.registerModule()
Module types: IconModule, FeatureModule, ExtensionModule, MenuExtensionModule
onInit() accesses container for service registration
Example: IconModule registers SVG icons, ExtensionModule adds form/table extensions

name: MigrationChecklist
observations: Step 1: Create bundle directory structure (src/assets/, components/, modules/, index.ts, main.ts)
Step 2: Add package.json with @pimcore/studio-ui-bundle, react, antd dependencies
Step 3: Add tsconfig.json with ESNext, react jsx, bundler moduleResolution
Step 4: Create WebpackEntryPointProvider.php and register service
Step 5: Create plugin in main.ts with IAbstractPlugin interface
Step 6: Create IconModule to register SVG icons
Step 7: Create API instances using EntityApi class
Step 8: Create Manager component using EntityTabbedManager
Step 9: Create Form component with Ant Design components
Step 10: Register widgets in plugin onInit()
Step 11: Test build and integration with Pimcore Studio

name: BestPractices
observations: Use EntityTabbedManager for standard CRUD - don't reinvent
Follow naming conventions: {Entity}Manager.tsx, {Entity}Form.tsx, {Entity}Select.tsx
Always export reusable components (Select components) in index.ts
Use extension registries for cross-bundle composition
Keep forms stateless - data flows from Manager via props
Use onChange callbacks for all data mutations
Implement buildSavePayload in Manager to transform data before save
Add extension slots in forms even if not immediately used
Use LocalizedFieldsProvider for multi-language fields
Wrap selects with DroppableEntity when entity references are needed
Register all icons in IconModule before using in UI
Use TypeScript interfaces for all entity types
Follow extension slot naming convention strictly

name: CommonPatterns
observations: Nested entities: Use inline Table with custom render functions in Form
Cascading selects: Pass parent ID as prop (e.g., StateSelect needs countryId)
Add modal: Use useFormModal() hook, call modal.input() for name
Grouping: Use GroupedEntityTabbedManager with groupBy prop
Tab state: Manager handles automatically, forms receive data/setData
Validation: Use Form.Item rules prop for Ant Design validation
Loading states: useState + useEffect pattern for async data
Drag types: Follow pattern 'coreshop:{entity}' in snake_case
Extension factory: Return array of column/field configs
Service access: container.get<Type>(serviceId) in module onInit()

name: TroubleshootingGuide
observations: If widget doesn't appear: Check WidgetRegistry registration and MainNavRegistry path
If icons missing: Verify IconLibrary.register() called in IconModule
If bundle not loading: Check WebpackEntryPointProvider.php service registration
If extensions not working: Verify extension slot naming matches exactly
If save fails: Check buildSavePayload transform and API endpoint
If TypeScript errors: Run npm run check-types, ensure interfaces defined
If build fails: Check dependencies installed, verify tsconfig.json settings
If drag-and-drop not working: Check dragType matches between Manager and DroppableEntity
If localization issues: Verify LocalizedFieldsProvider wrapping and currentLocale passed
Module Federation errors: Check @pimcore/studio-ui-bundle version matches

name: Separation of Concerns Principle
observations: CRITICALLY IMPORTANT for CoreShop Studio v2
Each Bundle creates and owns its own Registries
Each Rule Engine has separate ConditionRegistry and ActionRegistry instances
ProductBundle creates ProductPriceRuleConditionRegistry + ProductPriceRuleActionRegistry
OrderBundle creates CartPriceRuleConditionRegistry + CartPriceRuleActionRegistry
CoreBundle acts as the 'Glue' - retrieves all registries and registers shared components
Bundles only register what they know based on composer.json dependencies
Same action name can exist in multiple registries with different implementations
Future rule engines follow the same pattern

name: Bundle Registry Ownership Pattern
observations: Each bundle binds its registries to DI container as singletons
Bundle registers ONLY components it has dependencies for
Example: ProductBundle does NOT register CountriesCondition (no dependency)
CoreBundle has dependencies on ALL bundles
CoreBundle retrieves registries via container.get()
CoreBundle registers shared components into EACH registry
Check composer.json to determine where to register components
Documented in CLAUDE.md lines 148-239

name: Registry Separation Architecture
observations: Each bundle creates and owns its own registries for rule engines
ProductBundle creates ProductPriceRuleConditionRegistry and ProductPriceRuleActionRegistry
OrderBundle creates CartPriceRuleConditionRegistry and CartPriceRuleActionRegistry
OrderBundle also creates CartItemConditionRegistry and CartItemActionRegistry
CoreBundle acts as glue - retrieves registries from other bundles and registers shared components
Registries are bound to InversifyJS container as singletons
Each bundle registers only what it knows about based on composer.json dependencies
Uses generic ConditionRegistry and ActionRegistry from RuleBundle
No need for bundle-specific registry classes
Each bundle creates separate instances bound to different service IDs
Type-safe through TypeScript generics
All registries have same implementation (register, get, has, getAll)
Reduces code duplication significantly
